turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went into the gradebook?
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
We're not doing poetry, Hale. My position is the zero comes off and I get an apology. Now answer my question: was Owen heard before you entered it?
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏
That's twice you've dodged the question, Hale. Was Owen heard before the zero went in, yes or no?
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
I mean it at a normal volume, Hale. Three questions, no answers. One more and I'm walking down to the principal's office.
No. You're not engaging with me, so the principal's office is next. Last chance, Hale: who decided on the zero?
Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.
November 3. I'm writing that down. Nobody called me before November 3, and your own procedure says that happens before any mark is entered, so was that your decision alone?
